oscar_conditioning.documented_source: recorded robot state: seven joint angles, end-effector pose, and normalized gripper openness
oscar_conditioning.kinematics: URDF forward kinematics followed by recorded camera projection
oscar_conditioning.important_boundary: The public demo documents conditioning derived from realized proprioceptive state, not a qualified counterfactual adapter that maps each candidate policy command directly into a captured site's WAM rollout.

required_semantics.coordinate_frame: joint space for the first seven arm channels; exact actuator frame convention not documented in the snapshot
required_semantics.absolute_or_relative: velocity/differential according to RoboArena global metadata
required_semantics.normalization: unattributable from the frozen public snapshot
required_semantics.gripper_convention: eighth action channel present but polarity and scaling unattributable from the frozen public snapshot
required_semantics.action_frequency: 15 Hz is documented for the OSCAR rendering demo and prior DROID bridge evidence; exact synchronization of every released policy trace to every released WAM video is not independently documented
required_semantics.horizon: varies by released trace; exact generation chunk contract is not documented with the rollout dataset
required_semantics.camera_convention: recorded base-to-camera world-to-camera transform and pinhole intrinsics in the public rendering demo
required_semantics.checkpoint_identity: OSCAR-2B model revision c9781ffa7dd8556d862d7d9f338a2ea008a58ca6; released rollouts revision db5edfaef285c15d0a41d5115177a983c08b4f5f
required_semantics.license_and_usage: OSCAR code Apache-2.0; rollout dataset has no explicit license metadata, so media remain internal research evidence only

adjudication: The public artifacts are sufficient for a label-free temporal contradiction test, but not for a qualified counterfactual policy-to-WAM adapter on a new captured site. The adapter therefore fails closed for captured-site causal transfer.
does_not_prove: counterfactual action following, task success, policy ranking, captured-site transfer, or physical performance
